name: Protein–Protein Docking Benchmark
description: A curated benchmark of protein–protein complexes and evaluation metrics used to assess docking algorithms' ability to predict interaction poses.
reputation: Established and widely used standard benchmark in the protein–protein docking community for method comparison.
notes: Curated, relatively small set of complexes with per-target difficulty splits; evaluates 3D structural predictions (non-LLM); results sensitive to bound vs. unbound structures and decoy generation; not saturated across all difficulty tiers.
